procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: D, a claim on Labor Notes with the entity named; R, a relation the archive states between Labor Notes and an archive object; O, an archive category applied to Labor Notes or to a class the field and the census source for it (independent organs of the labor movement: B12, B2, census kind, area, evidence kind; rank-and-file reform caucuses and union democracy: B2, B12, B1, census area and record.keeps; strikes and labor action: B1, B2, B4, census area and negative tag). verdicts.reason: Ils ne sont pas marxistes (the census's anchor): the archive's category of the organ, the holder and the route of a defeated critique applied to independent organs (the SPD's journals, the New Reasoner, the leadership's monopoly of communication) and to the composing layer (O-class 1, independent organs); TDU and the counter-cases as one mechanism of an independent constituency, with its limit that these are unions and a movement (O-class 2, reform caucuses). The string pass returned no O candidate here (no category term the script reads); found by reading the class matches at p47–55, p136–140

Autonomous Semantic Warfare (Rex Fraction), §2.6 For movements and organizations: the labor movement's own lesson that company-controlled channels close once organizing works, so that independent media, union halls and alternative networks were 'structurally necessary' (O-class 1, independent organs of the labor movement); its category, infrastructure sovereignty, applied to the class. Found by the hop from #1725 (H0014); the class pattern does not read 'independent media'
